chunks: And ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
Indeed, I love to see a man actively engaged in seeking sustenance.
Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “O Allah, bless my Ummah in their early mornings.”

key_terms.بَارِكْ: grant blessing and increase in good
key_terms.مُتَحَرِّفًا: actively engaged and moving about in effort

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about seeking sustenance early in the morning?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام expresses love for seeing a person actively striving to earn lawful sustenance. The hadith supports diligence in seeking رزق and highlights the special blessing in beginning one's efforts early in the day, based on the saying of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
